description: This file exports a single function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that processes an array of cost records to produce a grouped dataset suitable for visualization, especially in a charting library like Recharts. It organizes data by agent name and groups by either environment or cost category, filling in missing categories with zero values to ensure consistency.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw aggregate records into a grouped dataset suitable for charting, supporting optional sorting and handling of unknown categories.

search-terms: populate data based on agent and category
